title: Removal of suspended solids from water by waste biomass-based cationized cellulose nanofibers: a comparative analysis of flocculation performance from different biomass sources
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01120A, Paper
Peng Lin, Jinglin Yuan, Mingyu Lei, Yi Jin, Sikai Chen, Han Zhang
This study extracted and prepared cationic nanocellulose (QCNFs) from four biomass waste sources as eco-friendly flocculants. Chemical structural and micromorphological analyses identified key determinants of QCNF flocculation performance.
